text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Help me out~!
There's something only McQueen can help with~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Only me...? Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You see, you see! I want you to play a baseball game with us tonight!
It's a dorm match, but we're soooo completely short on members!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My... Completely short, you say?
Well, if you insist so strongly...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as someone born in the homeland of baseball,
I will absolutely win, maas!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're not gonna lose either!
Alright then, play baaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Take this! Special Turbo Straight fastball~!
Zubababababaaa—!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice ball! Strike 'em out in all kinds of zones,
BANG, BANG! Let's do it, desu yo~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
The pitches are all over the place, it's so hard to hit—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Teio-san. Why not narrow down the zone you are aiming for?
Unless it arrives in your targeted zone, let it pass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And then, once it comes right into the pitch you've waited for—
a full swing! Put everything you have into that single strike!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm? You've been letting pitches pass this whole time!
Are you giving up??

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! The word "surrender" doesn't exist
in the great Teio-sama's dictionary!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mumu. But Turbo and the team are gonna win anyway!
Take thiiiiis!

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Here it comes!
...It's here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugyagyaaa—!!
A home run?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay—!!
Thanks, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, this much is natural.
I am glad my knowledge proved useful.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Noooo!!
To think Turbo's fastball would get blasted like that!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What do we do~!
Turbo's team is losing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do not be so disheartened. Scoring runs and conceding them
are both part of the true thrill of baseball, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if your fastball gets hit,
do you not possess other breaking balls in your arsenal?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I want fastballs!
Turbo wants a head-to-head showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If so, all the more reason...
Clashing with every single tool at your disposal with all your might!
That is what a true head-to-head showdown in baseball is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Curves and splitters are super fun, too, desu yo!
They go swooosh and bend, then drop sharp and clean, desu!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Swoooosh and then drop sharp and cleaaan-?!
Turbo's gonna try it!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, McQueen!
Why are you giving advice to the enemy team?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah! M-My apologies!
I got caught up in the heat of the moment... and just...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, Teio! This is where Turbo's team
pulls off a super mega comeback drama—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Game set!
We did it! It is Ritto Dormitory's victory, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So frustraaaating!!
But that was so much fuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You guys were pretty tough too, Turbo!
I got super nervous when you turned the tables in the 8th inning~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! I can't cool down like this!
Now I really want to go watch a game at a real stadium, ma-shi-ta~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! Let's all go together next time!
As an afterparty for our showdown, ya know?
Hey, McQueen, you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case...
I cannot possibly decline such a wonderful invitation, desu wa.

At a later date, I heard the tale of the
heated game tournament from <chrname>.
